patient discount

Patient discounts can be applied in various ways within the billing system. Specifically, there are user-wise limit discounts and date-wise discounts that can be utilized for patients. If a billing user has the privilege to give a discount, it can be applied on the billing screen up to the limits specified for that particular user. Additionally, if any date-wise discount is present for a patient against any service, that discount can also be applied.
